observation.command:
curl -s --max-time 10 -X POST "https://elastic.kulturhusetstadsteatern.se/khst-events/_search" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"size": 3, "query": {"bool": {"must": [{"range": {"tixStartDate": {"gte": "now"}}}]}}}' | jq '.hits.hits[] | ._source | {title: .drupalTitle, name: .tixName, date: .tixStartDate}'
